instruction: Pull over beside the dark SUV closest to us on the left.
paraphrases: Stop next to the nearby dark SUV on the left.|Park beside the prominent left-hand dark SUV.

instruction: Pass the dark SUV on the left, then stop behind the red car ahead.
paraphrases: Go past the left-hand dark SUV and stop behind the red car.|After the dark SUV on the left, pull over behind the red car in front.

instruction: Stop beside the white van on the left—correction, stop behind the dark car on the right.
paraphrases: Take the white van on the left—rather, the dark car on the right.|Stop behind the dark car on the right, not the white van on the left.
